_comment: The LinkedIn feed, by explicit selection. Membership in `picks` is the ONLY
thing that makes a piece eligible for LinkedIn — there is no window, no tier,
no word floor, no aging rule. Adding a line here is how a piece gets fed.
This file exists because the alternatives failed. A 12-month horizon let 2025
essays hold 2027 slots. A 2-month window plus sticky admission needed a second
mechanism to undo itself. A 1000-word floor silently governed all future
writing when the instruction had been to select from a known 37. Selection is
editorial, so it is stored as editorial rather than approximated by a rule that
`reviewed` records how far the source was actually read before picking:
full    — source read end to end (demo deck, or the essay itself)
summary — excerpt, takeaway, and opening read; not the full body
Do not upgrade a value without doing the reading. A pick marked `summary` is a
defensible shortlist entry, not a verified judgment.
Built 2026-08-09 from the last 30 days, using real dates: demo dates come from
git first-commit, not meta.json's month bucket, which ran up to two weeks early.

picks.why: 49 of 95 programs past their end date reported as live, 21 still taking signups; a consent near-miss nobody asked about; and it prices its own claim — proposals, not invoices
the census corrects itself against its own thesis and withdraws the claim; the strongest evidence-handling piece in the window
the top entry in his agent's character sheet is a sentence he never typed; one contaminating string is 1 in 10 signals, and stripping it halves the correction bucket
three grades of constraint — rule, valve, jig — and the discovery that the one line enforcing the constraint is the same line that swallows the evidence
the checker docks a draft for missing a phrase his own guide bans; 15% of the tone corpus was machine-written; and the email guide lost to its own no-guide control, 263 vs 171
newest demo, first commit 2026-08-08
66,000 stars, eight components, seven already covered — the argument, stronger here than in its tutorial
an invented figure survives every automated check he built; he went looking for the hole on purpose
the tool ran, fixed two real problems, and was gone in four days — working and existing durably are different properties
series entry point; twelve verbatim messages, and the honest failure report of the render that is simply gone
18,000 tokens of always-loaded schema replaced by ten commands, and the agent misusing its own tool on camera
122 pkills, 553 permission questions, a 41x replay multiplier — every guard traced to a counted waste pattern
controlled experiment on his own harness where the vanilla arm argued back and the configured one did not
"verified" is a sentence, not a fact — a migration passed its audit while production was broken
a production site publishing fiction because a migration sweep did exactly what it was told
the claudeish redesign retrospective — accent measured nine RGB points from Claude coral; the attractor traced to his own docs; ration beat coverage
a real AI storefront needs live model judgment inside merchant-owned schemas; bounded decisions, unchanged outcomes, and safe fallbacks must remain visible

nineteen commits of safety verbs ending in the feature's deletion, with 27 agent sessions that day and zero typed instructions in any of them; the contract test rewritten to assert the capability is gone; and the agent sent to fix it repeating the mistake

the wrong reason for a crash cost more than the crash — namespace 2 is OS_REASON_SIGNAL and subcode 0xb is SIGSEGV, both read out of Apple's own reason.h, while jetsam is namespace 1 and never appears in the string; and it keeps memory exhaustion labelled a hypothesis because the report says memoryPressure false at the instant of the panic

the safety layer held and the product still failed — a resubmit was refused correctly and then reported as a failure for a change already live on the page; plus the spec's own six-turn model-call cap sitting on the component that resembled the agent diagrams while the unbounded fan-out next to it got nothing

twenty-two connector processes at a day of uptime, every one of them reading enabled = false, and nothing had failed — the flag governs what starts next, not what is already running; third instance of the shape after 52 worktrees and 102 browser profiles, and it ships a one-line check the reader can run

the verifier fully audited the label it later compared against two quarter-sampled labels; the filter manufactured the rate, while the complete logs recorded 334 million tokens and an impossible 119-of-118 status
